request.prompt:
Scene begins from the attached reference frame. Daehan is shifted FAR RIGHT — occupying only the right 22% of the frame, with his left shoulder near horizontal 78%. The remaining LEFT 78% is a large EMPTY green chalkboard. Do not let any prop or body part intrude onto the board area. For the remaining 2.5s he faces the camera with a warm, welcoming smile, blinking naturally. Chalkboard MUST stay absolutely empty throughout — no chalk marks, no writing, no text, no scroll props. Composition: The character is Daehan: long silver-white hair, violet eyes, small confident smile, black durumagi hanbok, white inner collar, black gat (traditional Korean hat) with golden band and red tassels, black gloves on both hands. Medium shot, eye-level, 16:9 widescreen. STRICT FRAMING: Daehan is shifted all the way to the RIGHT EDGE of the frame, occupying ONLY the right 22%. His left shoulder sits roughly at horizontal 78% of the image. The LEFT 78% is an unobstructed EMPTY green chalkboard reserved for post-production typography — nothing (not the character, not any prop) may intrude into that area beyond its rightmost 2%. Do NOT render any text, letters, numbers, chalk marks, scroll props, or writing anywhere in the frame.

AVOID: photorealistic, realistic skin texture, western fantasy robe, modern suit, short hair, black hair, brown eyes, no hat, no gloves, extra fingers, deformed hands, dark horror tone, text, letters, numbers, Korean characters, subtitles, logos, watermarks, multiple characters, distorted face, blurry, low quality, scroll, paper scroll, hanji scroll, calligraphy scroll, paper banner, rolled paper prop, held document, centered character
